ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; the visible surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with isolated, high-intensity (white) punctate regions constituting <2% of the total area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped vertex with an approximate 105-degree internal angle; depth is deep relative to the surrounding trailing edge topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels along the continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; concave trajectory at the medial junction transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible semi-circular high-contrast white pixel cluster on the mid-left lobe; additional sparse high-intensity punctate spots localized in the lower central fluke region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct diagonal linear disruption (rake mark) of approximately 40 pixels in length on the distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular traumatic indentation creating a secondary notch immediately left of the median notch; evidence of significant tissue loss along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique secondary notch profile adjacent to the primary median notch.
